newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Japanese airline ANA to open Geneva office.
newsitem.headline: Japanese airline ANA to open Geneva office.

text.p: Japan's All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) is opening an office in Geneva to tap the large pool of potential international and Japanese business in and around the city, a spokeswoman said on Monday.

ANA, which currently has no flights into or out of Switzerland, says it now carries more passengers on its domestic and international routes than Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL), which operates daily between Tokyo and Zurich.
The ANA spokeswoman said the office, to be formally inaugurated on Wednesday by the company's vice-president Wataru Kubo, was part of an effort by the carrier to expand its network around the globe.
She told Reuters ANA hoped eventually to operate into Switzerland, but this could only come through agreement between the Japanese and Swiss governments.

"We see a big potential market from the United Nations and other international organisations here, as well as from the many multinational firms in and around Geneva, both in western Switzerland and neighbouring areas of France," she said.

Geneva is home to the U.N.'s European headquarters and key agencies -- the International Labour Organisation, the World Health Organisation and the International Telecommunications Union -- as well as the World Trade Organisation.

ANA presently flies from Tokyo and Osaka to several European capitals including London, Frankfurt, Paris, Vienna, Rome and Milan. Between the two Japanese cities and Vienna, it has a cooperation agreement with Austrian Airlines.
